summary: PBDB holds every variable the range-continuity test needs: per-genus and per-family first and last appearance fields, dated occurrences classified to genus and family, and collection and occurrence counts for sampling control. A separate monophyly check of the groups (the definitional-circularity obstacle) is not provided by PBDB and MorphoBank, the assessor-named source of cladistic matrices, returned HTTP 403.
next_step: Pre-register gap detection on PBDB occurrence ages per genus/family with a sampling-adjusted absence criterion; take a pre-cladistic classification or a fixed taxonomy version to limit circularity.
obstacles_confirmed: No deposited Sepkoski-style range compendium found; PBDB is the only source seen.
Taxonomic membership in PBDB is a database classification, not a test of monophyly.
